description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function named 'sugar_evalcolumn_old' which evaluates and substitutes variables within a string, primarily used for list view rendering in SugarCRM. It includes logic for handling parameters, global string replacements, JSON encoding, and integrates with Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_evalcolumn_old
methods.description: Evaluates a string by substituting variables from the rowData, handling special strings, JSON encoding, and assigning or returning the result.

methods.name: searchReplace
methods.description: Performs regex-based placeholder substitution within a string using data from rowData.
